name: Archivist Mara
dialogue: The old systems fail in patterns. Bring me useful material and I will share what still grows.

name: Machinist Harker
dialogue: Ashlands ore is worthless until you can move enough force through it. Bring me a gear that runs true.

name: Grower Nia
dialogue: Water is not the problem. Dirty water is. Fix the header and I can make the basin feed people again.

name: Liftwright Torren
dialogue: The mountain does not forgive weak joints. Show me steel that carries a real load.

name: Thermist Sela
dialogue: Heat is a circuit. Contain it, move it, and Frostline becomes survivable.

name: Deepkeeper Orum
dialogue: The relay below is not magic. It is a machine whose language we forgot.
